# Bdl (English voice for RHVoice)

The English voice Fasih uses for non-Arabic text. Taken from the RHVoice project (https://github.com/RHVoice/bdl-eng). Fasih lowers its level by 1.7 dB in voice.data (with tools/hts_edit.py) and sets gain=0.5 when it builds the add-on, so English is as loud as Aseel.
